column1: # MyST site themes measured as rendered: the reference for the web layouts (Ir.WebLayout).
# content: an invented three-page project (placeholder text, example.org), built with
#   `myst build --html`, served on 127.0.0.1 only and read in headless Chromium 151.0.7922.34
#   (Playwright 1.62.0), light scheme, 900 px tall, network beyond the loopback refused.
# face: the themes' system-ui stack fell back to DejaVu Sans, whose digit is 10.18 px at 16 px,
#   so a width in ch is (px - 116) / 10.18 where 116 px is the 7.25rem of insets and gaps.
# columns: layout, key, value, unit, tolerance (- where the oracle does not judge it), source.
# The oracle (scripts/html-oracle.lean, feature web-layout) judges each row with a tolerance at
# the viewport its key names; geometry only, the engine keeping its own faces and rhythm.
